concepts.name: The Smug Prophet & The Disappearing Billions
concepts.story_question: How did this charismatic man convince the world's richest investors to give him billions?
concepts.primary_subject: Cutout photo of Adam Neumann with long messy hair, smiling barefoot in a navy suit
concepts.secondary_object: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son puppet looking stunned through thick glasses holding a burnt check
concepts.composition: Neumann cut-out large on right side (35% frame width), giant distressed textured stamp '$47B → $0' in bold yellow/white on dark navy corkboard left, subtle red string linking to SoftBank logo

concepts.name: The 33-Day Death Spiral
concepts.story_question: How does a company lose 90% of its value in one month?
concepts.primary_subject: Giant bold typography: '$47 BILLION' with a massive red line crashing off the bottom of the canvas
concepts.secondary_object: Real SEC S-1 filing page with yellow highlighted text: 'NET LOSS: -$1,900,000,000'
concepts.composition: Giant torn document center, massive red arrow slashing down, Adam Neumann puppet head peeking from behind the torn paper looking stressed, '33 DAYS' stamped in red courier stamp

concepts.name: The Fake Metric Receipt
concepts.story_question: What was the trick hidden inside their accounting?
concepts.primary_subject: Forensic paper document with torn edges titled 'COMMUNITY ADJUSTED EBITDA'
concepts.secondary_object: Yellow marker line crossing out '-$1.9 BILLION' and handwritten red pen note: '+ PROFITABLE*'
concepts.composition: Close-up angled document top-down with paper clips and pushpins, high-contrast yellow highlighter on the fake metric, Adam Neumann miniature puppet running away with bags of cash in bottom corner

concepts.name: The $700M Golden Parachute
concepts.story_question: The company collapsed, but how did the founder get richer?
concepts.primary_subject: Adam Neumann cutout leaning back relaxed sipping Don Julio 1942 tequila
concepts.secondary_object: Gulfstream private jet blueprint and burning office chair
concepts.composition: Neumann center-right, glowing bold text top left on dark charcoal paper texture, paper money confetti falling with posterized stop-motion edges

concepts.name: Renting Desks at Tech Multiples
concepts.story_question: Why was a real estate company priced like Apple and Google?
concepts.primary_subject: A simple cheap office desk with a coffee mug and sticky note
concepts.secondary_object: Giant glowing price tag pinned to desk: '$47,000,000,000'
concepts.composition: Desk illuminated under single vintage examination lamp in center, massive bold red question text 'JUST RENT?' above it, photocopier halftone texture
